newsitem.title: USA: Clinton picks Labor Dept. official for OPIC board.
newsitem.headline: Clinton picks Labor Dept. official for OPIC board.

text.p: President Clinton has decided to appoint Bernard Anderson, a Labor Department official, to the board of directors of the Overseas Private Investment Corp., the White House said Wednesday.

Anderson, currently the assistant secretary for the Employment Standards Administration at the Labor Department, had run his own economic and management advisory firm in Philadelphia before joinging the administration.
OPIC has a 15-member board that sets its underwriting and lending policies.
The White House made the announcement in Michigan, where Clinton was campaigning for next week's election.
